name: POW Pointer Probe
description: Four cells on a clean ROM. It asks one question: does a POW move's identity live at its combo.GDA row, so that pointing a character's move slot at another row gives them that move for real - animation, minigame, hit count and all - rather than a renamed copy of their own? Shadow's slot 1 is pointed at Knuckles' Uppercut row and his slot 3 at Cream's Refresh row, and those two rows are re-owned to Shadow so he can use them alone. His other four slots are untouched and are the control. No row contents are copied anywhere.
